note: EXP-INT-002 development arm: EXP-INT-001 PRIMARY C0 arm on mtn-r2-vary-v1: identical to run-mtn-r2-vary-v1-vo-only.json (same frames, metric readout, height channel, authoritative nadir-camera heading, estimator, recenter behaviour, readout) plus the relocalization layer under the frozen policy reloc-c0-primary.json (DEC-INT-007) fed by the exact-identity North+West skyline profiles. The only intended difference from the VO_ONLY arm is that the layer may move the persistent position on an accepted re-anchor. CASE-B ARM: identical to the plain config plus the pre-registered synthetic_hard_loss block. The ONLY difference from the EXP-INT-001 frozen policy reloc-c0-primary.json is min_retry_gap_frames 30 -> 20 (DEC-INT-008): the retry gap must not exceed the skyline capture interval (15 m at 7.5 m/s at 10 Hz = 20 frames), otherwise every second capture is skipped after an unsuccessful attempt (the EXP-INT-001 case-B finding). Gate, radii, fusion, recency, insertion and exposure bound are unchanged. mtn-r2-vary-v1 is a DEVELOPMENT recording (one of the five EXP-INT-001 calibration recordings): any result on it is a development proof-of-benefit, not a held-out evaluation.

synthetic_hard_loss.note: EXP-INT-001 case-B (hard-loss recovery) arm, pre-registered 2026-09-08 BEFORE any recovery result was seen: two forced losses on mtn-r2-vary-v1 (a DEV recording with no natural loss) at frame 450 (45.0 s, after the 30 s trusted-insertion window has filled and 15 s before the GT revisit of frame 22 at frame 598 / 59.8 s) and frame 1000 (100.0 s, 15 s before the closing revisit of frame 9 at frame 1148 / 114.8 s). Both arms lose at the same frames; VO_ONLY stays UNKNOWN after each loss, INT may recover on an accepted re-anchor. No e_before exists across a gap and none is fabricated.
